messages:
anya: heads up — i pushed a tweak to .github/workflows/eval-pr.yml. splitting the matrix so quantize=true runs the lightweight smoke eval on PRs, quantize=false keeps the full eval on nightly.

sam: nice. was that to reduce PR turnaround from the full 20m run?

anya: exactly. PRs were getting blocked by the full quantize runs. now PR -> quick-smoke (5m) + artifact upload, nightly -> full matrix.

jess: saw one PR where the artifact upload to s3 kept getting 403s during the smoke job. any ideas?

sam: linking logs: `ci-bot` showed upload attempts hitting presign expiry when runner queueing delayed start. looks like presign TTL is 5m and our GH Actions parallelism + hosted runner cold start sometimes goes ~7m.

mike: that matches what i saw on Saturday — hosted runners got delayed and the presigned URL expired before the job tried to push results.

anya: proposed fix: move presign generation into the job step immediately before upload, instead of generating at job start. can update the action to call `s3_presign` step right before `push-artifact`.

jess: or extend presign TTL to 15m as a stopgap. but i prefer the generate-late approach. less surface area.

sam: we also need to think about buildkite runners for the nightly full matrix. currently we fanout shards from GH Actions to buildkite via `buildkite-trigger` and the orchestration sometimes overwhelms the runner pool leading to queue-thundering.

anya: yeah — the new schedule 'nightly-juggle' I added intentionally staggers shard triggers but i don't think GH Actions -> BK handshake respects jitter. code:```yaml
# snippet from .github/workflows/eval-nightly.yml
jobs:
  trigger-shards:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Trigger buildkite shards
        uses: actions/http-client@v1
        run: |
          for i in $(seq 1 8); do
            curl -X POST "$BK_TRIGGER_URL" -d '{"shard":'$i',"model": "v2-onboard"}' &
            sleep $((RANDOM % 6))
          done
```

mike: that sleep jitter is fine but because GH Actions spins up multiple steps in parallel the seeds end up correlated. we should compute jitter from the job matrix index + some hashed seed and cap to 30s.

jess: also suggest adding `retry` on the presign upload step and a circuit-breaker if artifact count > 50 to avoid hammering S3/ingress.

ci-bot: buildkite: triggered pipeline `eval-v2-onboard` (8 shards). queue positions: [12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18, 19].

anya: next actions: 1) I'll move presign into the upload step in the PR workflow (small PR). 2) mike will update jitter seeding for shard triggers. 3) sam/jess to add retry/circuit on artifact upload. can we target these for today so PR gating stays fast? :thumbsup:

sam: ack, i'll do retry + TTL bump as emergency fallback.

mike: ack, i'll push jitter seed change and a small test to simulate correlated sleeps.

jess: i'll open the PRs and tag reviewers. also adding a tiny smoke check in the console dashboard so we can alert when PR-smoke duration > 7m.

anya: perfect — will follow up with a short post to #eng-oncall if we flip TTL or change presign behavior.

mike: one more note: quantize=true smoke should not upload the full artifacts, only the eval-summary.json and token-diff. reduces upload pressure.

anya: good call. i'll gate the upload step on `$QUICK_SMOKE == true` to limit payload.

jess: thanks all, seems we have a clear path. i'll monitor tonight's run and report back.
